## 1. Introduction

The study of the effects of climate change on biodiversity has become increasingly important in recent years. As global temperatures rise and weather patterns shift, ecosystems around the world are experiencing significant changes that threaten the survival of many species. This paper aims to explore the key findings from recent research on how climate change impacts various aspects of biodiversity, including species distribution, population dynamics, and ecosystem functioning.

## 2. Key Findings

### 2.1 Species Distribution Shifts

One of the most notable effects of climate change on biodiversity is the shifting of species distributions. Many species are moving toward higher latitudes or elevations in search of more suitable habitats. For example:
